description: A shell script for fixing prebuilt ELF check errors by updating 'shared_libs' fields in Android.bp files, involving functions for property manipulation, ELF dependency extraction, and file modifications.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: exit_handler
methods.description: Handles cleanup on script exit, removing temporary files.

methods.name: trim_space
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from input string.

methods.name: get_prop
methods.description: Retrieves property value from MODULE_PROP_VALUES_DICT for a given module and property.

methods.name: rewrite_prop
methods.description: Rewrites a property in the Android.bp file using bpmodify.

methods.name: get_dt_needed
methods.description: Extracts needed shared libraries from ELF file using readelf.

methods.name: unique
methods.description: Returns unique sorted list of input items.
